free_tier.stated: Free plan 'Limited': 2 GB disk space, no file expiry, unlimited download speed; the page shows the slot count as 1 active slot in one tab and unlimited in the others.

per_object_cap.stated: The 2 GB disk bounds what one torrent can hold on the free plan; paid plans 100 GB and 500 GB.

retention.stated: No file expiry on any plan per the pricing page.

egress.terms: Unlimited download speed on every plan per the pricing page; the home page states a maximum of 1 Gbps.

interface_detail: Web upload of a .torrent or magnet link, then an HTTPS download of the fetched files; no API is documented on the pages read.
tooling: Browser only on the pages read.
chaining: Fetch a torrent into the 2 GB free disk, download over HTTPS, delete, repeat; paid plans raise the disk to 100 GB or 500 GB.

limits.value: free plan 2 GB disk; Standard 100 GB; Premium 500 GB
active slots: 1 on the free plan in one tab, 5 on Standard, 20 on Premium

binding_note: Disk size is the metered limit on every plan; speed is stated as unlimited.

identity_cost.detail: An account is required (JOIN NOW leads to a registration form); The registration form fields were not readable, so the email requirement is unverified.

reliability_note: A third-party list reports the same free 2 GB and a $5.99 and $9.99 pair for the paid plans.
confidence_note: First-party pricing page; the three tabs on it are not labelled with their billing periods in the capture, so the period of each price is unverified.

evidence.proved: the free plan has 2 GB disk and no file expiry
